title: Photoshop Retouching Essentials: Healing Brush, Clone Stamp, Patch Tool, Liquify, Vanishing Point, and Teeth/Eye Enhancements
summary: This YouTube tutorial from Bring Your Own Laptop presents a comprehensive, technique-forward approach to Photoshop retouching. Across multiple segments, the presenter demonstrates non-destructive workflows and precise tool applications for improving facial skin, eyes, and teeth, while also showing how to handle large edits and perspective-based composites. The course launches with Healing Brush fundamentals and layered non-destructive editing, then moves into Clone Stamp and Patch Tool tricks, followed by advanced use of Liquify (including Face Aware Liquify), Vanishing Point for perspective-based mockups, quick skin tone selections, and culminates with in-depth eye and teeth retouching. The video repeatedly emphasizes working on separate layers, masking, and using adjustment layers to keep edits reversible and controllable, with exercise files and class projects included for hands-on practice.

sections.title: Healing Brush foundations and Layered workflow
sections.description: Introduction to Healing Brush on a dedicated Retouch layer, with guidance to sample from all layers and to avoid edges, setting up non-destructive edits before proceeding.

sections.title: Healing Brush advanced techniques and opacity control
concepts: Brush hard/soft, sampling points, Shift joining
sections.description: Advanced tips for larger corrections, using Shift to join sampled regions, and adjusting opacity for realism while edits stay on a dedicated Retouch layer.

sections.title: Clone Tool Stamp overview
sections.description: Initial look at cloning as a copy-paste brush, highlighting when to prefer cloning to preserve hard edges and avoid milky blends.

sections.title: Clone Source rotation and multi-source sampling
sections.description: Technique for rotating clone sources to match angles and textures, with tips on sourcing light and texture from multiple points for realism.

sections.title: Patch Tool introduction and use for larger edits
sections.description: Patch Tool as an intentionality-based replacement method for larger areas, including how to sample from a chosen source region and refine with Deselect and subsequent touch-ups.

sections.title: Liquify and Face Aware Liquify workflows
concepts: Forward Warp / eyes, lips, jaw adjustments
sections.description: Comprehensive Liquify demonstration with face-aware controls, linking facial features, and methods for subtle vs. extreme adjustments; emphasis on non-destructive practice via Smart Objects.

sections.title: Vanishing Point: perspective planes on walls
sections.description: Intro to using Vanishing Point to create planes for textures on walls, including defining planes and testing alignment using white reference squares.

sections.title: Vanishing Point: advanced plane duplication and blending
concepts: Blending modes within Vanishing Point context
sections.description: Further Vanishing Point techniques, including duplicating planes, merging with transformed layers, and managing edges for realistic compositions.

sections.title: Skin tone quick selections and color balance
sections.description: Efficient methods for quick skin selections using Color Range, Skin Tones presets, and color balance adjustments to warm skin tones while preserving non-skin areas with masks.

sections.title: Eyes retouching: Phase 1 (saturation, dodge & burn)
concepts: Dodge & Burn on eye highlights and shadows
sections.description: A phased approach to eyes: saturate iris color, then apply dodge to brighten highlights and burn to deepen pupils, using a separate Retouch layer for toggling opacity.

sections.title: Eyes retouching: Phase 2 (faking detail and color tweaks)
concepts: Custom eye color and subtle highlight work
sections.description: Second phase explores more advanced, semi-artificial eye detail using brushes and blending modes, including eye color tweaks and subtle edge definition for realism.

sections.title: Teeth whitening workflow with group-layer efficiency
sections.description: Teeth whitening using colorization, a white fill layer with masking, and grouped masks for multi-image reuse; final color balance and levels to restore natural tooth shade and contrast.
